register.labelZh: CRASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: crash around、crash about 和 crash round 可以描述人或動物走動時弄出很大聲響;crash down則可以描述沉重物件伴隨巨響倒下。；crash out 是自然的口語表達,用來表示某人因為非常疲倦而很快睡着。；crash out of a cup、tournament 或 competition 表示某名球員或某支球隊落敗,無法繼續參賽。；知道 around、about 和 round 可以表達相同的嘈吵走動意思,能幫助你理解更多對話和故事。
register.summaryEn: Crash around, crash about and crash round describe people or animals moving very noisily. Crash down describes something heavy falling with a loud noise. Crash out is a natural informal expression for falling asleep very quickly because you are extremely tired. Crash out of a cup, tournament or competition tells you that a player or team has lost and cannot continue. Knowing that around, about and round can express the same noisy-movement meaning helps you understand more conversations and stories.
